goal: Integrate the existing provider-truth Work Unit selector and governed materialization planner into one deterministic fail-closed continuation decision path without broadening mutation authority.
scope: consume fresh provider truth and the canonical selector outcome before deriving any continuation decision
when exactly one canonical executable Work Unit is selected, deterministically continue that selected Work Unit without materializing a second Work Unit

when the selector returns NO_WORK and the governed frontier is ACTIVE, derive only the exact PLAN_ONLY materialization proposal and leave Issue creation to the separately authorized reusable materialization transaction
fail closed on stale base SHA, incomplete or ambiguous provider truth, selector/planner disagreement, or frontier drift
preserve the reusable canonical materialization grant, Writer Lease grant, merge/Issue-close grant and all immutable materialization anchor bytes unchanged
keep continuation evaluation hosted and read only; no provider mutation is performed by the planner/selector integration itself
forbidden_scope: grant new Issue-create, branch, pull-request, Writer Lease, merge or Issue-close authority
mutate provider-state, Writer Lease semantics or reusable authority grants
mutate ADWF Consumer binding/provenance or the ADWF repository
perform runtime or product/runtime source mutation
perform release/tag/promotion, ruleset/policy administration, PRIVATE evidence publication or 1080/1081 lifecycle mutation
exit_criteria: fresh provider truth deterministically yields either one exact selected canonical Work Unit or NO_WORK
selected-Work-Unit and NO_WORK continuation paths are mutually exclusive and fail closed on stale or contradictory inputs
NO_WORK can produce only the exact PLAN_ONLY planner proposal while Issue creation remains governed by the existing reusable materialization grant
selector, planner, materialization policy, reusable materialization grant and Work Unit schema immutable anchors remain byte-exact
exact-head hosted CI passes with no provider-state, ADWF, product/runtime or 1080/1081 mutation
